blocks.text: 等愛的人 等無船回航
blocks.spelling: tán ài ê lâng tán bô tsûn huê hâng

blocks.text: 飄浪的人 心情真沈重
blocks.spelling: phiau-lōng ê lâng sim-tsîng tsin tîm-tāng

blocks.text: 無奈的我 忍心將你放
blocks.spelling: bô-nāi ê guá lím-sim tsiòng lí pàng

blocks.text: 異鄉的我 為你夜夜夢
blocks.spelling: ī-hiong ê guá uî lí iā iā bāng

blocks.text: 男兒心聲 啊～飄浪的運命
blocks.spelling: lâm-lî sim-siann ah～ phiau-lōng ê ūn-miā

blocks.text: 無論霜雪 也是風寒 那攏無算啥
blocks.spelling: bô-lūn sng-seh ia̍h-sī hong-kuânn he lóng bô sǹg siánn

blocks.text: 唯一的 心痛 是心愛的在阮夢中
blocks.spelling: uî-it-ê sim-thiànn sī sim-ài ê tsāi gún bāng-tiong

blocks.text: 不時叫著阮的名
blocks.spelling: put-sî kiò-tio̍h gún ê miâ
